children: Thailand's foreign tourist arrivals dropped 3.12% year-on-year in the January 1 to September 5 period to 21.28 million visitors, the Tourism Ministry said on Monday.
Tourism, a key driver of Southeast Asia's second-largest economy, had a record of nearly 40 million visitors in 2019, before the pandemic.
